name: Generate diverse fictional narratives from detailed prompts
description: Users requested the generation of diverse fictional narratives, ranging from fantasy and sci-fi to humorous or interactive stories, often providing detailed prompts about characters, settings, and plot points. The requests varied in scope, including single short scenes, interactive segments, or multi-part sequences, but consistently focused on creative writing tasks distinct from specific reproductive scenarios.
